d:
Bihar vidhanasbha ke neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ne navnirvachit vidhan parshadon (MLC) ke shapath grahan samaroh, raghopur pul par huee ghatna ko lekar sanjay jha ke bayan tatha nitish setu ke udghatan men nitish kumar ki anupasthiti aur namakran ko lekar apni pratikriya di hai.
Nirdaliy jitkar bijepi men shamil hone vale do sadasyon par jataee aapatti
